name: Navel orange
selection: Heavy for its size with firm, tight skin. Surface russeting is cosmetic. A light fruit is a dry fruit.
storage: Counter for a week, refrigerated for up to a month.

varieties.name: Cara Cara
varieties.note: Pink flesh, low acid, faintly berryish. A navel mutation.

varieties.name: Washington
varieties.note: The standard navel, and what an unlabelled navel bin almost always holds.
